2022-337.purpose: sought to establish an Office of Climate Resilience.

2022-338.author: Speier
2022-338.purpose: incentivizes states to enact, at a minimum, the rights afforded to victims in the Survivors Bill of Rights Act.

2022-339.author: Pallone
2022-339.purpose: prohibits the President from selling or exporting new F-16s or F-16 upgrade technology or modernization kits to Turkey unless the President provides a certification to Congress that such a transfer is in the national interest of the United States and includes a detailed description of concrete steps taken to ensure that such F-16s are not used by Turkey for repeated unauthorized territorial overflights of Greece.

2022-340.author: Garamendi
2022-340.purpose: sought to waive current laws requirement that FEMA or federal land management agencies reimburse DOD (with civilian funds) for cost of military support for disaster response to major wildfires or federally declared disasters/emergencies.

2022-341.author: Langevin
2022-341.purpose: allows for admission of essential scientists and technical experts to promote and protect the national security innovation base.

2022-342.author: Schiff
2022-342.purpose: prohibits the use of evidence obtained by or with the assistance of a member of the Armed Forces in violation of the Posse Comitatus Act in a court or other legal proceeding.

2022-343.author: Green, Al (TX)
2022-343.purpose: provides statutory authority for certain procedures related to the Community Development Block Grant - Disaster Recovery (CDBG-DR) Program and add new program requirements.

2022-344.author: Connolly
2022-344.purpose: prevents any position in the competitive service from being reclassified to an excepted service schedule that was created after September 30, 2020 and limit federal employee reclassifications to the five excepted service schedules in use prior to fiscal year 2021.

2022-345.author: Neguse
2022-345.purpose: adds the text of the Colorado Outdoor Recreation and Economy Act and the Grand Canyon Protection Act to the bill.

2022-346.author: DeGette
2022-346.purpose: adds the text of Titles I - VI of the Protecting America's Wilderness and Public Lands Act, and adds the text of the Cerro de la Olla Wilderness Establishment Act.

2022-347.author: Evans
2022-347.purpose: reauthorizes the Delaware River Basin Restoration Program and increase the federal cost share for certain grant projects. The amendment also extends the program through FY2030 and increases the federal cost share of a grant project that serves a small, rural, or disadvantaged community to 90% of the total cost of the project.

2022-348.author: Connolly
2022-348.purpose: to reduce the sunset provision for Section 5112(c) of the Department of State Authorization Act of 2021 (Division E of Public Law 11781) from 2 years to 1 year.

2022-349.author: Meng
2022-349.purpose: directs the VA to conduct an awareness campaign regarding the types of fertility treatments, procedures, and services that are available to veterans experiencing issues with fertility, covered under the VA medical benefits package.

2022-367.purpose: Amendments en bloc No. 1 comprised of amendments numbered 1, 18, 31, 44, 53, 79, 83, 97, 118, 128, 139, 151, and 160, printed in Part A of House Report 117-420.

2022-368.purpose: Amendments en bloc No. 2 comprised of amendments numbered 2, 4, 5, 8, 26, 33, 34, 36, 37, 40, 42, 46, 47, 48, 49, 50, 52, 56, 57, 59, 60, 61, 64, 65, 69, 74, 75, 76, 77, 81, and 96, printed in Part A of House Report 117-420.

2022-370.purpose: Amendments en bloc No. 4 comprised of amendments numbered 13 and 179, printed in Part A of House Report 117-420.

2022-380.author: Tlaib
2022-380.purpose: sought to prevent the funds made available by this act from being made available to implement, administer or enforce section 908(b) of the Trade Sanctions Reform and Export Enhancement Act of 2000 (22 U.S.C. 7207(b)), prohibition on financing of agricultural sales to Cuba.

2022-381.purpose: Amendments en bloc No. 8 comprised amendments numbered 183 and 184, printed in Part A of House Report 117-420.

2022-411.author: Schrier
2022-411.purpose: adds language to expand pre- and post-fire weather assessments to include identification of data collection gaps, accuracy and efficiency of fire weather forecasting, and post-incident assessments.

2022-412.author: Velazquez
2022-412.purpose: to revise the collateral requirements so borrowers can obtain a disaster loan for up to $25,000 from the Small Business Administration without pledging any collateral.

2022-431.author: Hice (GA)
2022-431.purpose: sought to ensure that a policy similar to Schedule F could be reinstated in the future by the President.

2022-433.purpose: Amendments en bloc comprised of amendments numbered 1 and 3, printed in Part E of House Report 117-464.

2022-434.author: Hice (GA)
2022-434.purpose: sought to eliminate for-cause removal requirements of the Director of the Census Bureau, strike the requirement that the Deputy Director position be a career-reserved candidate and certain qualifications for the position, and add that the Deputy act as the Director in the event of a vacancy in the Director position.

2022-436.purpose: Amendments en bloc comprised of amendments numbered 1, 2, 3, and 4, printed in Part C of House Report 117-464.

2022-502.author: Gonzalez, Vicente
2022-502.purpose: requires the Secretary of Homeland Security to promulgate regulations to implement this Act not later than 90 days after the date of enactment of this Act.
